text: Candidates for the position of Women's Officer must identify wholly or partly as a woman or transfeminine.
Candidates for the position of Domestic Officers must run in pairs.
Candidates for the position of Entertainment Officers must run in pairs or triples.
One of the three Welfare Officer positions shall be reserved for members who identify as a woman or a minority gender.
One of the three Welfare Officer positions shall be reserved for members who identify as a man or a minority gender.
Members who have already nominated for a position in the same set of elections may not nominate themselves again.

Members who have any position on the following bodies OR any of the following positions are ineligible for nomination to any JCR Officer position:
\begin{enumerate}\setlength{\itemsep}{1pt}
\item Oxford Union Executive Committee (President, Librarian, Treasurer, Secretary)
\item Oxford Union Executive Committee Elect (President-Elect, Librarian-Elect, Treasurer-Elect, Secretary-Elect)
\item Oxford Union Standing Committee
\item Oxford Union Standing Committee Elect
\item Oxford Union Senior Appointed Team
\item Oxford Union Senior Access Officer
\end{enumerate}
Members who hold a position on the Oxford Union Secretaries Committee are ineligible for nomination for JCR Exec roles.
Members who are Treasurers of a financial beneficiary of the JCR (e.g. Ball Committee), are ineligible for nomination to be JCR Treasurer.
No member may be a candidate in a by-election held in Trinity Term in fifth week or later if they are not in residence of St John's College, Oxford for the following Michaelmas Term.
